word.item: It is I Indeche Valgan, I am here with a story that grandmother told me and that story goes like this.
We had a child and that child was with her mother.
Her father was not there, her father had died.
Now that child learning in school was very difficult.
Now her uncles from the side of her mother come and take that child.
Now when they come to take her, they cheated her mother.
Mother to that child, "you give us this child we want to take her where to school."
Now when her mother heard that she gave those uncles that child.
They took her, they went with her.
now the child finished almost seven years like this.
She was not coming to check on her mother.
She left and went to the home of uncle, of her uncles who came to take her.
Now when she went there like that, she went to check her child.
When she went to ask, they told her, "this child has gone to posho mill, she is not there."
She waited on, she waited on, ai
She was seeing evening was coming. She returned.
She said "let it be, I will come to see her tommorow."
Coming the following day, she came to ask, "have you seen my child?
Has that child returned, is she there?
I just want to see her, I have desires of seeing her."
She does not want to see you because you refused to educate her.
She has gone to see who her aunty."
She finished days like a week, she returned.
When she returned, she came and asked, "where is my child?"
Before she finished saying "where is my child," six small drums came from bedroom, playing and singing like this:
Tindi ndindi I am in vegetable
Tindi ndindi I am in vegetable
They are cheating mother I am in vegetable
They want baby sitter I am in vegetable
They went to slaughter me I am in vegetable
They made small drums I am in vegetable
Six small drums I am in vegetable
Now the child’s mother did not feel well.
She asked her brothers, "I hear them singing and I am not hearing well, things are singing from the bedroom there.
And singing that they are singing they are saying you have killed my child."
Those uncles I do not know, they were not hearing.
They told her "you go, you will return, we want to check they are which things."
Woman said "ung’ng I want to hear those things they are singing, because I am hearing voice is coming from bedroom there.
Which voice, is he not of my child is the one in the bedroom there?"
They told her, "no your child went to her aunty when we see her.
Now if you want well, you go and see her at aunty’s place, then you will return if you do not find her there you ask aunty, she will she will have returned here.
That woman went up to the place of the aunty and she did not find the child.
She checked from all her aunties place, she did not find the child, she returned.
When she returned, she now heard small drums playing very well singing:
Tindi ndindi I am in vegetable
Tindi ndindi I am in vegetable
They are cheating mother I am in vegetable
They want baby sitter I am in vegetable
They went to slaughter me I am in vegetable
They made small drums I am in vegetable
Six small drums I am in vegetable
That woman when she heard that voice, when she heard it well, and those uncles were standing there.
As she held their clothes and asked them "why did you cheat me?
You want to educate for me, yet you have brought her to work instead.
You have not brought her to work.
You have gone to slaughter her.
Now you hear voice coming from there."
She took them to police station because of their cheating.
They went to stay in jail.
